title: Un-gated companion: T5 base text encoder (for Stable Audio Open Small)
notes: Hugging Face files pinned to a 40-digit commit; bytes and SHA-256 from the repository tree API (lfs.oid) for model.safetensors, and from downloading the three small non-LFS files on 2026-11-25. Only the safetensors weights and the tokenizer/config files; the flax, TensorFlow, Rust and pytorch_model.bin copies are left out. Model files are data: never executed. About 894 MB in total.

sources.notes: Revision a9723ea7f1b39c1eae772870f3b547bf6ef7e6c1. Not gated (the API reports gated=false). This is the text encoder that Stable Audio Open Small loads at run time (the model itself is gated and is downloaded by the owner, see docs/library/GATED_MODELS.he.md); that the library finds it at this location has not been run. The repository has no separate LICENSE file; the licence is stated in the model card.
